name: ArchiveX – Custom Archive Page Templates for Month, Year & Group
author: Akshar Addons

sections.description:
ArchiveX helps readers explore older WordPress posts by month or year. It groups archive content into responsive tabs and loads additional posts with AJAX, making long blog histories easier to browse.

Use ArchiveX on a blog homepage, archive landing page, sidebar, or content area. Choose a monthly or yearly date format, customize archive headings and colors, and display posts in responsive list or grid templates.

🚀 Key Features

  • ✅ Monthly archive and yearly archive tabs.
  • ⚡ AJAX loading for additional archive posts.
  • ↔️ Previous/Next AJAX pagination in the free version.
  • 🧩 Responsive archive post grid and list layouts.
  • 🎨 Customizable heading text and archive tab colors.
  • 📱 Multiple widget instances for sidebars and content areas.
  • 🧱 Gutenberg block and Elementor widget support.
  • 🔗 Shortcode support for pages, posts, templates, and widgets.

🧩 Shortcodes

Monthly archive tabs:

[archivesposttab widget_title="Monthly Archives" date_format="month_year" number_of_post_display="8"]

Yearly archive tabs:

[archivesposttab widget_title="Yearly Archives" date_format="year" number_of_post_display="8"]

🎯 Perfect For

  • Personal blogs with years of published content.
  • News and magazine archive pages.
  • Corporate newsrooms and publication libraries.
  • Sidebar archive navigation and content hubs.

🔧 How It Works

  1. Edit a page or post.
  2. In Gutenberg, add a Shortcode block. In Elementor or a supported page builder, add a shortcode element.
  3. Paste a monthly or yearly ArchiveX shortcode.
  4. Select the archive date format, choose a responsive template, and publish the page.
  5. Visitors can switch archive tabs and load posts with AJAX.

⭐ Premium Features

Upgrade for advanced archive filtering and presentation:

  • ⚡ Load More, Previous/Next, and numeric AJAX pagination buttons.
  • 🧱 Custom post type archive support.
  • 🧱 Elementor widget and Gutenberg block controls for premium settings.
  • 🔎 Search controls for posts in each archive tab.
  • 🎨 10+ responsive templates and hover animation effects.
  • 🔗 Dynamic multiple shortcode creation for content areas.
  • 👁️ Show or hide post counts, empty categories, dates, comments, author names, and author images.
  • ↕️ Sort and order archive results by month or year.
  • ⭐ Open a selected month or year by default and add an All tab.
  • ↔️ RTL support and adjustable spacing between post items.
  • 🖼️ Controls for post image, title, excerpt, pagination, and read more link.

sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin from Plugins > Installed Plugins.
  3. Edit a page or post and add a Gutenberg Shortcode block, Elementor shortcode element, or supported page builder shortcode element.
  4. Paste one of the monthly or yearly 1[archivesposttab]` shortcode examples.
  5. Select the date format and configure the layout, then publish the page.
sections.faq:
Can I show monthly and yearly archives?

Yes. Use date_format=”month_year” for monthly archive tabs or date_format=”year” for yearly archive tabs.

Can I display archives in a grid?

Yes. The plugin includes responsive archive post list and grid templates.

Can I use more than one archive widget?

Yes. Multiple archive tab widgets can be configured for different areas of your site.
